title: Case-aware navigation to native investigation and administration screens
scope: Connect Vati cases to verified native Jube and OpenAleph destinations in new tabs; retain case context and expose Frappe Desk only to permitted staff.

acceptance.text: Create server-authorized destinations from configured allowlisted origins and mapped IDs; verify deployed browser route patterns, encode identifiers, never include credentials and independently test native permissions.

Officer case links open the correct Jube case and OpenAleph collection/entity/graph; taxpayers and unauthorized staff cannot obtain or use destinations; missing mappings, unavailable or recorded-only services and separate native login requirements have honest states.

Keep the Vati case tab and breadcrumbs; move showcase out of operational navigation; provide permitted Frappe Desk entry; document separate-session logout behavior and capture relevant viewport/keyboard/accessibility evidence.
Record tests and limitations, update evidence and open a PR; do not claim native runtime readiness from fixtures.

verification: Authenticated synthetic native-screen and connected navigation checks; denied access, unavailable service and documented human visual review.
notes: Added by TAX-105 from user-requested complete frontend/native UI scope; not implemented or claimed.
